title: Occupation of Ningbo
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Occupation of Ningbo", at revision 1370630225, opens: "The Occupation of Ningbo was the five-month period in 1861 and 1862 during which the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom successfully occupied the city of Ningbo during the Taiping Rebellion. British and French support eventually allowed the Qing to retake the city." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q48801180, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1861–1862 occupation by the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
